description: This file defines the DirectoryEntry class, which models a directory entry in an Android gallery application. It encapsulates the entry's name and resource ID, and provides methods to retrieve the associated Drawable and Bitmap objects from resources.

classes.name: DirectoryEntry
classes.description: Represents a directory entry with a name and resource ID, and provides methods to access its visual representation as Drawable or Bitmap.

methods.name: DirectoryEntry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DirectoryEntry with a name and resource ID.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the directory entry.

methods.name: getDrawable
methods.description: Returns the Drawable associated with this directory entry, given Resources.

methods.name: getBitmap
methods.description: Returns the Bitmap associated with this directory entry, decoded from resources.
